claim: CENPIC (rev-2 picture data, the ground truth for the shipped rev-4 picture chips) sets .RADIX 16 — every hex literal in this file is base-16.
Region 0x000-0x7FF (starting at .=0) is the LOWER bitplane for the 8x16 motion-object stamps — chip 136001.201, PLANE_LOWER.

corroboration.note: ROM_START(centiped) gfx1 region 0x1000, ROM_LOAD("136001-211.f7", 0x0000, 0x0800, ...) — chip 211 (== vendored 136001.201, same SHA1) loads the first half.

claim: The .=200 block (region 0x200-0x3FF within the lower plane) is the 8x8 playfield stamp block: BLANK, A-Z, CIRCLE C/P, DOT, ONE HALF, GUN, 0-9, four COLOR blanks, COLON, then the poison/plain mushroom growth stages — 8 bytes each, unlabelled (.BYTE + ;comment only). GREEN names these by the CHAR_/DIGIT_/MUSHROOM_ convention (no CENPIC label exists).
The .=400 block holds the ODD-numbered motion objects (HEAD1,3,5,...,SHOT,BUG1,3,5,7,ANT1,3,SCORP1,3) — the even/odd split that gives HEAD0..HEADF their interleaved offsets.

Region 0x800-0xFFF (.=800) is the UPPER bitplane of the same 8x16 motion-object stamp layout — chip 136001.202, PLANE_UPPER. The upper-plane byte for a stamp at lower-plane offset X is region[X+0x800].

source.verbatim: .=800			;UPPER BIT OF 8 X 16 MOTION OBJECT STAMPS

corroboration.note: ROM_LOAD("136001-212.hj7", 0x0800, 0x0800, ...) — chip 212 (== vendored 136001.202, same SHA1) loads the second half; gfxdecode's spritelayout planeoffset {RGN_FRAC(1,2),0} (centiped.cpp:1722-1732) confirms the planar 2bpp split and that pixel x=0 is the MSB.

claim: The .=800+200 (0xA00) block mirrors the .=200 tile block byte-for-byte layout as the upper-plane copy of the same playfield stamps.
The .=0C00 block holds the ODD-numbered motion objects' upper-plane bytes, mirroring .=400 the same way .=800 mirrors .=0.

HEAD0 (the first centipede head/body sprite frame) is a labelled 8x16 stamp at region offset 0x000 — CENDEF.MAC's motion-object picture numbers 0-7 all index this one HEAD0..HEADF pool for head, body, and poisoned variants (no separate BODY sprite set).
GUN (the player's gun motion-object stamp) sits at region offset 0x080.
BUG0 (the first spider frame) sits at region offset 0x0A0 — BUG0..BUG7 are the spider's 8 motion-object frames.
ANT0 (the first flea frame) sits at region offset 0x0E0 — ANT0..ANT3 are the flea's 4 motion-object frames.
SCORP0 (the first scorpion frame) sits at region offset 0x180 — SCORP0..SCORP3 are the scorpion's 4 motion-object frames.
SHOT (the player's fired shot) is a labelled 8x16 motion-object stamp at region offset 0x480.
HEADS is HEAD0's upper-plane byte at region offset 0x800 (== 0x000 + PLANE_SIZE) — the mirror invariant that lets PLANE_UPPER be indexed directly by the same lower-plane offset.

corroboration.note: gfx_layout spritelayout: {8,16, RGN_FRAC(1,2), 2, {RGN_FRAC(1,2),0}, {0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7}, {0*8,...}, 16*8} — plane 1 from the region's second half, plane 0 from the first, confirming the 0x000/0x800 mirror this claim set decodes against.
